senses.gloss:
1. सु सु, i. 1, and ii. 2, Par., and सू सू, ii. 4, सुय (properly pass. refl. of सु), and ii. 2, Ātm.
 1. To beget, Man. 10, 32.
 2. To bear, to bring forth, Man. 10, 39; Pañc. pr. d. 5. ii. 5, सुनु, Par. Ātm. (the act of expressing the Soma juice being compared to the act of generating, cf. Rigv. i. 28), To express the Soma juice, Chr. 294, 3 = Rigv. i. 92, 3.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. सुत,
 1. m. A son, Pañc. i. d. 185.
 2. f. ता, A daughter, Chr. 3, 9.
 3. m. pl. Children, Man. 2, 28.
 --Comp.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, षु,
 1. To express the Soma juice, Rām. 1, 13, 5 (cf. Schlegel's translation).
 2. To extract juice, Man. 5, 10.
 3. To sprinkle, Bhaṭṭ. 9, 90.
 --With उद् उद्, ii. 5, To agitate, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 35 (cf. 2. सू).
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To beget, Man. 10, 30. []
 2. To bring forth, Man. 4, 44.
 3. Pass. To be brought forth, Man. 10, 36; with the termination of the Par. (i. 4, Par.), MBh. 12, 5687. प्रसूत,
 1. Engendered, Hit. pr. d. 23, M.M.
 2. Born, Pañc. 45, 2.
 3. Produced, Chr. 294, 8 = Rigv. i. 92, 8.
 4. Engendering, Man. 3, 19.
 5. Having brought forth, delivered, Hit. 72, 14; Utt. Rāmac. 52, 1 (she has brought forth).
 --Comp.
 --Comp.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र,
 1. To beget, Man. 10, 33.
 2. Pass. To be brought forth, MBh. 3, 12978 (with the termination of the Par.).
 --Cf. ὕω, υἱός, ὑστέρα; Goth. sunus; A.S. sunu (cf. सूनु).
2. सु सु, i. 1, and ii. 2, Par. † To possess power or supremacy (cf. the last).
3. सु सु, i. 1, Par. Ātm. † To go.

4. सु सु (for original वसु, cf. εὖ, ἐΰς; ἐάων = Zend. वङ्ह्व्ãम् = Sskr. *वस्वाम्),
 I. adv. ved. Beautifully, Chr. 296, 1 = Rigv. i. 112, 1.
 II. Very seldom combined and compounded with a verbum finitum; e. g. Pañc. i. d. 205, but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 647; but very often with nouns,
 1. Good, well, Rām. 3, 53, 6; Ṛt. 6, 2; Lass. 15, 5.
 2. Beautiful, beautifully, Rām. 3, 52, 35.
 3. Much, very, Chr. 4, 12.
 4. Easily, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 2. Comparat. सुतराम्,
 1. Better.
 2. With न, Very badly, Pañc. 199, 24; with मा, In no way, Megh. 108.
 3. More, Śiś. 9, 67; Pañc. 163, 3.
 4. Exceedingly, Śiś. 9, 55.
 5. Consequently, of course.
 --Cf. εὖ.

2. सू सू, i. 6, Par.
 1. To cast, to send.
 2. To incite, to impel.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. सूत.
 1. Sent, dispatched.
 2. Gone, departed, Pañc. 176, 4; see s. v.; see 1. सु with उद्.
 --Cf. perhaps σεύω, σοῦμαι; Lat. sævus.

3. सू सू,
 A. (1. सू),
 I. f. Birth.
 II. As latter part of comp. words,
 1. Bringing forth, yielding; e. g. काम-, adj. Yielding wishes, Ragh. 5, 33.
 2. A father. कुमार-, m. A name of Agni, father of Kumāra, the god of war, MBh. 2, 1148.
 3. One who has brought forth. जीव-, adj. f. One who has borne a living child, MBh. 1, 7353. f. A mother. विचित्रवीर्य-, f. The mother of Vicitravīrya.
 B. (2. सू), in स-असु-, adj. Having arrows, Kir. 15, 5.
